item.name: CART-AI-040A - User A add isolation marker

exec: pm.test("Success message matches spec", function(){ const j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property("message","Added to cart"); });

item.name: CART-AI-040B - User B verify no User A marker

exec: pm.test("User B cannot see User A marker", function(){ const arr=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(arr.some(x=>x && x.name==="USER_A_ONLY")).to.equal(false); });
pm.test("Success message matches spec", function(){ const j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property("message","Added to cart"); });
pm.test("Success message matches spec", function(){ const j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property("message","Added to cart"); });

pm.test("Same id can coexist with contradictory metadata in current implementation", function(){ const a=pm.response.json().filter(x=>x && x.id===800001); pm.expect(a.length).to.be.at.least(2); pm.expect(a.some(x=>x.name==="Canonical Name" && x.price===500000)).to.equal(true); pm.expect(a.some(x=>x.name==="Tampered Name" && x.price===1)).to.equal(true); });

item.name: CART-HUM-002A - User A add private marker

exec: pm.test("Success message matches spec", function(){ const j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property("message","Added to cart"); });

item.name: CART-HUM-002B - User B add private marker

exec: pm.test("Success message matches spec", function(){ const j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property("message","Added to cart"); });
pm.test("User A sees A_PRIVATE", function(){ const a=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(a.some(x=>x && x.name==="A_PRIVATE")).to.equal(true); });
pm.test("User A does not see B_PRIVATE", function(){ const a=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(a.some(x=>x && x.name==="B_PRIVATE")).to.equal(false); });
pm.test("User B sees B_PRIVATE", function(){ const a=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(a.some(x=>x && x.name==="B_PRIVATE")).to.equal(true); });
pm.test("User B does not see A_PRIVATE", function(){ const a=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(a.some(x=>x && x.name==="A_PRIVATE")).to.equal(false); });

item.name: CART-HUM-003A - update profile after JWT issuance
CART-HUM-003B - old JWT still accepted for cart

exec: pm.test("Previously issued signed JWT remains accepted after profile-state change", function(){ pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("Success message matches spec", function(){ const j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property("message","Added to cart"); });
pm.test("JWT ownership remains User A", function(){ pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test("Current implementation persists arbitrary extra fields", function(){ const x=pm.response.json().find(i=>i && i.id===840001); pm.expect(x).to.exist; pm.expect(x.debug).to.equal("secret-marker"); pm.expect(x.user_id).to.equal(999); });
